name: Advanced Huge Monstrous Crab
appearance: An immense aquatic crab that guards Wave. The encounter gives no shell color or armor.

habitats: Membrane dome by the boiling lake

Special attacks and qualities.name: Improved grab
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: After a claw hit, the crab can attempt a grapple as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity. A successful check establishes a hold and lets it constrict.

Special attacks and qualities.name: Constrict
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: A successful grapple check deals 4d6+8 constrict damage.

Special attacks and qualities.name: Amphibious
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: The aquatic crab survives indefinitely on land.

Encounters.name: Wave guardian
Encounters.effectNote: The 107 HP crab attacks intruders in the membrane dome. While fighting it stays at least 5 feet from the walls whenever possible.

notes: Neutral. Intelligence shown as a dash. Toughness as a bonus feat. Space and reach are both 15 feet.
White Plume Mountain (2005 D&D 3.5 revision), Area 17, pp. 20–21. The adventure prints this full advanced stat block on p. 21.

name: Large Monstrous Scorpion
appearance: A large terrestrial scorpion with crushing claws and a stinging tail.

attacks.name: Full attack: one sting plus poison

Base creature rules.name: Improved grab
Base creature rules.effectNote: A claw hit allows a free grapple attempt without provoking attacks of opportunity. The scorpion uses the higher of Strength or Dexterity for the grapple check.

Base creature rules.name: Constrict
Base creature rules.effectNote: A successful grapple check deals 1d6+4 automatic claw damage.

Base creature rules.name: Sting poison
Base creature rules.effectNote: The sting carries poison. Fortitude DC 14. Both initial and secondary damage are 1d4 Constitution.

Encounters.name: Desert Terrace
Encounters.effectNote: Encounter Level 6. As soon as a character sets foot on this level, three Large Monstrous Scorpions surround the intruders and attack from all directions. Each has 32 HP. Each scorpion is CR 3.

Encounters.name: Separate a victim
Encounters.effectNote: After establishing a grapple, a scorpion that wins another grapple check can pull the target 25 feet from the party as a standard action. Another scorpion can take its place. They fight to the death.

notes: The Large column leaves alignment unstated and shows Intelligence as a dash. No feats listed. Space 10 feet, reach 5 feet.
Base combat figures are from the 3.5 Monster Manual p. 287, as referenced by the adventure, and match the revised SRD Large Monstrous Scorpion.
White Plume Mountain (2005 D&D 3.5 revision), Area 26C, p. 27 supplies the encounter’s numbers and tactics.
